## Overview

An elderly woman who was entrusted with Nyra's parents' mystery box before they disappeared. She was also Nyra's childhood caretaker -- the beautiful black-haired woman who looked after Nyra when her parents were away. She has been watching over Nyra her entire life. She guarded the mystery box for years, believing Nyra had also vanished, until she searched Nyra's mountain home. She delivered the box to Nyra on her 18th birthday and has since become a source of information about Nyra's parents and their elemental research.

---

## Appearance

Gray hair, wrinkled skin, bright eyes. Movements are deliberate and careful, suggesting age but also hidden competence. Dressed in simple, worn clothing typical of a city dweller. When Nyra knew her as a child, she had long black hair and was well-preserved for her age (50s), with bright eyes that have not dimmed.

---

## Background

Ghavel was a close associate of Nyra's parents during their research, and served as Nyra's caretaker when her parents visited the city (2-3 days per week). Before they disappeared, they entrusted her with their research box and a single instruction: if anything happened to them, hide it in their city house and keep Nyra safe. She did both -- hiding the box and watching over Nyra from a distance.

When Nyra's parents vanished, Ghavel searched for Nyra as well, but found no trace. She assumed the child had perished or been taken along with her parents. It was only when she finally searched Nyra's abandoned mountain home that she discovered evidence Nyra was still alive -- and still in the region. Khel'vin had taken her deep into the mountains, beyond Ghavel's reach.

On Nyra's 18th birthday, Ghavel tracked her down through the city's merchant network and delivered the box. She chose not to reveal her former identity as the caretaker, waiting for Nyra to piece it together or for the right moment.

---

## Current Status

Alive. Remains in or near the city. Serves as Nyra's point of contact for information about her parents' research. Nyra does not yet know Ghavel was her childhood caretaker.
